title: What tactics will Burnham use to sell his EU plans? – podcast
summary: Andy Burnham has set out his plans to win parliamentary backing for a new EU deal. But the various options for how Britain could rejoin the EU, or ‘Breturn’, will not be outlined until December.…
byline: Presented by Pippa Crerar and Kiran Stacey, produced by Nada Smiljanic and Madelynne Flack, music by Axel Kacoutié; the executive producer is Maz Ebtehaj
